section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the high prevalence and debilitating effects of depression and loneliness in old age, highlighting their co-occurrence and established predictors. It identifies a gap in research regarding the role of parental satisfaction with adult children's achievements on later life depression and loneliness. The present study hypothesizes that feelings of gratitude and perceived support from children will mediate these relationships, drawing on existing literature to support these assumptions.
